subject: Request: Executive approval for 28% Hosted API concession — Helix Therapeutics
messages:
From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@helixtx.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai
Cc: sales@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-20T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API pricing follow-up — need an aggressive onboarding rate

Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Helix is excited about the latency and the batch pricing you showed. We ran the usage forecast with the product team and, assuming we commit to a 12‑month ramp to 200M tokens/mo, we need a more aggressive onboarding discount to make the economics work for our board.

Specifically, can you escalate for an ~30% off list unit rate for the first 12 months (with a standard commit schedule)? We can commit to monthly minimums and provide a purchase order once terms are agreed. Attached is our ramp/usage forecast and a short SOW.

Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

—Alex
Alex Jenkins
VP Product, Helix Therapeutics
alex.jenkins@helixtx.com
Attachment: usage-forecast-helix.csv (csv)
Attachment: Helix-SOW-draft-v3.pdf (pdf)

From: irene_choi@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, alex.jenkins@helixtx.com
Date: 2027-06-21T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Hosted API pricing follow-up — need an aggressive onboarding rate

Ben / Marcus —

Looping you in on Helix. They are asking for ~30% off for the first 12 months tied to a committed ramp to 200M tokens/mo. Attached is their forecast and an SOW draft. Quick summary of my take:
- Revenue upside: predictable 12‑month committed volume, strong chance to expand after ramp.
- Risk: 30% is outside standard concession bands and would materially reduce margin on hosted endpoints without batching/quantization applied.

Proposal: recommend we authorize a 28% concession for the first 12 months if we get:
  * Firm monthly minimums in the MSA (>= 30% of forecast in months 1–3),
  * Prepay for first quarter or PO on signing, and
  * Standard no‑refund clause for early termination.

This keeps the economics close to their ask while giving us controls. Can you confirm whether you can sign off or if we should escalate to Senior?

Thanks — I can provide quick margin modeling if helpful.

—Irene
Irene Choi
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai
Attachment: helix-cost-analysis.xlsx (xlsx)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, alex.jenkins@helixtx.com
Date: 2027-06-25T14:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Hosted API pricing follow-up — need an aggressive onboarding rate

Irene — thanks for the summary and the analysis. A few quick points before we get Marcus to weigh in:

1) Margin impact: our modeled unit cost for Helix at the target sequence distributions + batching improvements is roughly $0.00035/token. At 28% off list that yields a slim margin on early months; we need clarity that they will enable batching and agree to quantization guidance.
2) Contractual guardrails: agree that PO/prepay for Q1 plus no‑refund early termination protects us. Add a clause requiring usage telemetry access for cost-optimization checks.
3) Precedent: authorize up to 25% at SDR level; >25% requires Senior sales approval.

Marcus — can you authorize 28% for a 12‑month introductory concession with the three contract conditions above? If not, please indicate max you can approve and any additional conditions.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Strategic Sales, Redwood Inference

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, alex.jenkins@helixtx.com
Date: 2027-06-29T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Approval: 28% concession for Helix Therapeutics — conditional signoff

Team — after reviewing the numbers and the upside potential, I approve a 28% Hosted API rate concession for Helix Therapeutics on the following terms:

1) Commitment: 12 months with monthly minimums equal to 30% of the forecast in months 1–3, escalating to the full forecast by month 6.
2) Payment: PO on signature and prepay or credit card on file for the first 90 days.
3) Telemetry & ops: Helix must provide usage telemetry access and agree to enable batching and follow quantization guidance within 60 days of go‑live. Failure to implement optimizations will trigger a rollback clause to the prior rate.
4) No early termination refunds.
5) Legal to include a bespoke clause documenting the concession and gating renewal on adherence to the commit.

Irene, please finalize the SOW and MSA language with Legal and get countersigned PO. Alex — grateful for the partnership; we look forward to a smooth onboarding.

Marcus Lin
VP Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Attachment: approval-note.txt (text)
